scope: Re-review of the frozen architecture, requirements, decisions, and status; verify all three round-1 repairs and their coherence. No feature implementation or empirical behavior is claimed.

requirements_and_spec_fit.reason: The three previously incomplete contracts are now explicit in the architecture and mirrored by R-037/R-038/R-040/R-041/R-049. Codex scope, two skills, independence, and migration boundaries remain intact.

architecture_and_coherence.reason: Cause-responsive execution, generation-aware retrieval, and class-specific promotion now connect through the existing plan/log/record contracts without adding a scheduler or new subsystem.

correctness_and_evidence.reason: Scoped facts, transferable heuristics, and causal guidance require distinct evidence predicates; confounded success stays provisional and independent review cannot substitute for evidence. Applying these predicates reliably remains an empirical question for later gates.

simplicity_and_context_efficiency.reason: Repairs add short decision contracts to existing components. Bounded cue/generation refresh deduplicates loaded revisions; instruction-first helpers and the inline path remain. The added text is justified by real previously ambiguous branches.

orchestration_and_model_routing.reason: Requested routing priors and native lifecycle semantics remain correct against the supplied live schema. A failed criterion now requires causal diagnosis and bounded responsive changes while preserving user model constraints.

safety_reversibility_and_recovery.reason: Single-writer and unknown-effect barriers are retained. Recovery now explicitly rebuilds projections only from valid logs; promotion accepts reconciled terminal failures and stops while excluding unknown-effect inputs; exact knowledge generations/revisions are recoverable.

verification_strength.reason: Verification-first, held-out evaluation, anchored per-dimension review, and same-case baseline comparison remain credible design contracts. New support/retry/refresh rules now yield falsifiable negative cases for the next builder.

reporting_and_maintainability.reason: Requirements and decisions agree with the repaired design; round-1 failures and the builder's unscored repair claims were preserved. Static design approval remains explicitly separate from implementation and measured task quality.

dispositions.verification: Static contract check: a repeatably verified local invariant qualifies only within its scope; a joint model-and-prompt change remains provisional; transferable and causal guidance require evidence beyond reviewer assent. Class and rationale are persisted.

Static trace check: repeated partial worker results require unmet-criterion evidence and a causal hypothesis; unchanged indistinguishable failure cannot receive the same dispatch. Finite allowances force a materially changed plan, preserving user model choices and allowing continued distinct safe strategies.

Static trace check: initial no-match followed by a known failure cue triggers retrieval before retry. Unchanged cues/generation avoid reload; changed generations trigger status/qualifier revalidation; selected generation and revisions survive recovery.
Valid authoritative logs can rebuild stale/missing projections; invalid logs pause admission.
Successful, failed, and stopped terminal runs are eligible when integrity-valid and effects are reconciled; active/unknown-effect runs are excluded.

limitations: Design approval only. No deterministic suite, installed workflow, held-out task, quality/cost comparison, or knowledge transfer has been executed by this review.
Qualitative evidence judgment and cause diagnosis must still prove useful and consistent in forward tests.
Requested critic placement is recorded; effective model/effort and spend are not independently observed.
External source claims were not independently revalidated; the supplied live collaboration schema is the authority for the reviewed tool semantics.
